title: The Vicar of Morwenstow: Being a Life of Robert Stephen Hawker, M.A.

The opening portion sets the tone for Hawker's life as both a celebrated poet and a curious figure, filled with humorous anecdotes that hint at the adventures and challenges he would encounter as he sought not just to fulfill his duties as a clergyman, but also to express the beauty and struggles of life through his poetry.
